greeting.websiteHelp: The first line visitors see when they open the chat on the website.
greeting.noWidget: There is no website chat on this account yet. Add one on Integrations.
greeting.agencyOnly: The website greeting is managed by Lead Awaker.
greeting.whatsappHelp: On WhatsApp the customer writes first and the assistant answers, so there is no opening message to set.

behaviour.agentNameHelp: The name the assistant introduces itself with.
behaviour.languageHelp: Used until the customer's own language is known.
behaviour.toneHelp: How the assistant sounds, in a sentence. Saved for the language you are using the app in.
behaviour.tonePlaceholder: e.g. Warm and straightforward, plain words, no hype
behaviour.repliesHelp: At most this many short messages in one turn. Each extra message is billed.
behaviour.voiceHelp: Whether a WhatsApp voice note may be answered with a voice note.

voiceModes.voice_reply: Voice note back to a voice note

behaviour.handoff: Hand over on the first request for a person
behaviour.handoffHelp: On: when someone asks for a person, the assistant says a colleague will get back to them and stops replying. Off: it first tries to help.
behaviour.stopHelp: When someone asks it to stop, says it is the wrong person or is rude, the assistant says one polite goodbye and the chat ends. Chats that are booked, handed to a person or opted out never get a follow-up.

knowledge.title: What it knows
knowledge.descriptionHelp: A few sentences on what the business does. Saved for the language you are using the app in.
knowledge.kbHelp: Facts it may use: products, prices, address, how appointments work. It does not make up anything that is not here.
knowledge.accountKb: Also use the account's Company Intel
knowledge.accountKbHelp: Adds the facts collected during onboarding to what the assistant knows.
knowledge.bookingLinkHelp: Shared when a customer wants to pick a time themselves.

followUp.title: Follow-up
followUp.help: When a WhatsApp chat stops in the middle of something, the assistant may send one short message to pick it up again.
followUp.switchHelp: At most one per silence. A new one only after the customer writes again.
followUp.whenValue: 3 to 20 hours after the assistant's last unanswered message
followUp.whenHelp: Only inside the active hours, only on WhatsApp (website visitors have left). This window is fixed.
followUp.whatValue: One line about what they were asking, or nothing when the chat ended naturally. The customer's status is never changed.
followUp.notReceptionist: This campaign uses the reactivation follow-ups. They are set on the Campaigns page.

hours.title: Active hours
hours.help: Customers who write get an answer at any time. The follow-up is only sent inside these hours.
